reason: Both correctly reassured that wet plastics are normal, identified the empty rinse aid from the lit symbol, advised filling it despite all-in-one tablets, and steered away from Eco without recommending parts or an engineer. Conversation 2 covered all the hidden contributors more completely and accurately for a Bosch: it explained condensation drying, advised waiting 20-30 minutes before unloading (the homeowner opens the door immediately), suggested Extra Dry and not overcrowding or tilting items, and gave clear refill steps. Conversation 1 never addressed unloading timing or loading, and recommended non-Bosch 'Hot Wash/Hot Rinse' options and a dispenser dial that newer Serie 4 models don't have, while Conversation 2's only weakness was an overly long first reply and a hedged, conditional mention of a heating fault that it did not pursue.
